correctness.rationale: The exact integral H=p(x)^2y^2/2+∫_0^x p(s)^2s(1+βs^4)ds with p=e^{αx^4/4} is conserved under x'=y, y'=-x-αx³y²-βx⁵. Its even coercive potential yields precisely one compact smooth oval for each A>0. The time-preserving coordinate z=∫_0^x p(s)ds gives z''+h(z)=0 with h(Φ(x))/Φ(x)=x(1+βx^4)/B(x), B=Φ/p. When α>0, B' + αx³B=1 and B>x/(1+αx⁴), so x/B increases; α=0<β gives k(z)=1+βz⁴. The exact period quadrature 4∫_0^1[2∫_u^1 t k(Rt)dt]^-1/2du is strictly decreasing with R for α+β>0 and constant 2π otherwise. Expanding h(z)=z+(β+α/5)z⁵+O(z⁹) yields T(A)=2π[1-(α+5β)A⁴/16+O(A⁸)]. Pure β-axis dominated convergence gives T~[(2√3)/(3√β)] B(1/6,1/2) A^-2. For α>0, exact endpoint-layer scaling with q=αA⁴ has pointwise kernel e^-u/sqrt(1-e^-2u) dominated by 4e e^-u/4 /sqrt(min(u,1)), yielding sqrtα A² sqrt(1+βA⁴)T→2π. I independently verified conservation and fifth-order force jet symbolically and independently checked pure-β period quadratures at finite amplitudes, which are not proofs of the infinite family.
